scope.claim_limit: Four step admission/continuation process-halt seams and two fresh recoveries per seam only. Successful continuation receipt records command handling; original job operation remains outcome_unknown. Saved pre-run material values are not crash-time consumption recovery.

privacy.public_transformation: Summary uses fixed facts, counts, key names and digests. Raw request/session/token values, commands, private absolute paths and arbitrary native payloads are excluded.
